main_body: A flat grass ground patch (4x3 tiles) in green with a repeating tuft pattern; terrain tile, not a standing object
top_band: none; a uniform ground texture with no top band and no front face (repeating tufts every 16 rows)
evidence: Terrain ground tile: a flat grass surface with a repeating tuft motif. It is not a standing object, so the top/front contract does not apply. There is no side face, no wall or cliff structure and nothing drawn in elevation. Kind matches terrain.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 6 distinct colours and a median of 6 per tile, against 26 per tile and 80 colours for the reference grass. The ramp has about 4 greens (dark green, mid green, light green, highlight) plus a few orange marker pixels. The tuft pattern repeats exactly every 16 px, so it reads as a mechanical stamp. Dark pixels are tinted green rather than neutral, so the outline lean is fine, and there are no flat 5x5 fills. It is clearly thinner than the Beodeul grass in shading steps and colour variety, which makes it look simpler and more tiled.
